preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The size of the array N must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element A[i] in the array must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the rotation index and the maximum number of inversions for each test case.
The rotation index must be the smallest index that maximizes the number of inversions.

postconditions.expression: max_inversions == max(inversions(k) for k in range(N))
postconditions.description: The maximum number of inversions must be the highest count found among all rotations.
